notes: The Nor rests on the waw alone, since the second clause writes no negative for it to fuse with (rule 35).

Rule 25's distributed-negative reading was considered and rejected: rule 35's closing sentence gives a single word carrying both coordination and negation to the waw where the Hebrew gaps the negative, exactly as in the neither built up precedent.
In the second clause the ASV writes two words (and not), so the waw and אַל each take their own English rather than fusing.
